title: Optimization Utilities
summary: This module provides utility functions for program optimization, including patching forward passes for tracing, appending rules and demonstrations based on feedback, and logging token usage during optimization trials.

nodes.label: Patch Program Forward Pass
nodes.title: Patched Forward Pass
nodes.description: Intercepts and modifies the forward pass of a program to enable tracing of execution, especially for handling parsing errors and logging failed predictions during optimization.

nodes.label: Append Optimization Rule
nodes.title: Append a Rule
nodes.description: Generates and appends a new optimization rule to a program's predictors based on contrasting good and bad execution trajectories, aiming to improve future performance.

nodes.label: Append Few-shot Demo
nodes.title: Append a Demo
nodes.description: Adds a few-shot demonstration to a program's predictors based on successful execution traces, helping the model learn from good examples.

nodes.label: Offer Feedback Signature
nodes.title: Offer Feedback Signature
nodes.description: Defines the signature for generating advice to program modules, contrasting better and worse execution trajectories to provide concrete, actionable feedback.

nodes.label: Log Token Usage
nodes.title: Log Token Usage
nodes.description: Extracts and logs the total input and output token usage for each language model involved in an optimization trial, providing insights into resource consumption.

nodes.label: Calculate Proposed Quality
nodes.title: Calculate Proposed Quality
nodes.description: Evaluates the average and best quality of recently proposed programs over a specified number of trials, assessing the effectiveness of optimization proposals.

nodes.label: Get Task Model History
nodes.title: Get Task Model History
nodes.description: Retrieves the full execution trace and history of a task model for a given candidate program, useful for detailed analysis and debugging during optimization.

groups.label: Execution Tracing & Feedback
groups.title: Execution Tracing and Feedback
groups.description: Components responsible for monitoring program execution, capturing traces, and generating feedback or demonstrations to improve program performance.

groups.label: Evaluation & Logging
groups.title: Evaluation and Logging
groups.description: Utilities for evaluating the quality of proposed programs, logging resource usage, and inspecting model execution history during optimization trials.
